title: NIR Emitting Scintillators Based on CsI Single Crystals
content: The development of efficient scintillators emitting in the red and/or infrared spectral range represents an important scientific challenge, as such materials could find numerous practical applications. This work studies newly grown CsI:Yb,Sm and CsI:Eu,Sm single crystals demonstrating red and infrared luminescence. We measured luminescence spectra in the visible and near-IR range, excitation spectra across visible, UV, VUV, and X-ray ranges, Raman absorption spectra, and thermoluminescence spectra. The results show that divalent europium and ytterbium ions can efficiently transfer excitation to samarium ions. The measured X-ray light yield reached 37,000 photons/MeV for CsI:Yb,Sm and 40,000 photons/MeV for CsI:Eu,Sm.
